deterministic_queue_order: lexicographically smallest action_id as final deterministic tie-break

guards: action generation and session_generation are current
valid_transitions.notes: Only the application service may perform the durable claim.

guards: generation/session generation no longer current OR stale_after exceeded before claim
replacement action exists and references predecessor
required safe precondition is unavailable and scheduler chooses terminal replacement rather than wait
all local_plan steps required before human interaction have confirmed idempotent receipts

valid_transitions.notes: Retry is a new replacement action, never mutation back to QUEUED.

effects: record whether local effect state is NONE_CONFIRMED or UNKNOWN
valid_transitions.notes: Never auto-requeue. Scheduler may issue a replacement after reconciliation.

guards: generation became stale AND adapter confirms no local effects were applied
claim lost/expired or continuity changed and local side-effect outcome cannot be proven

valid_transitions.notes: This does not assert that Ctrl+V/Enter occurred; it means local preparation is complete and the system now waits for an authoritative durable event.

guards: scheduler intentionally replaces action before durable ack is accepted
effects: record replacement; ignore late ack for control progression

guards: scheduler creates a newer recovery/retry action and explicitly supersedes predecessor
effects: late predecessor acknowledgments become stale/orphan evidence, not control progression

guards: acknowledgment has passed required deterministic transition/validation checks

retry_rule.method: create new OperatorAction with new action_id and generation as needed, referencing supersedes_action_id

local_only_drain_rule.description: One Ctrl+B dispatch may execute zero or more atomic local-only actions with post_local_success=COMPLETE_AND_REQUERY, then re-query and claim at most one human-interaction action.
local_only_drain_rule.motivation: Preserves one-hotkey UX for retire/discard/maintenance without hiding partial failure in one composite durable action.

claim_expiry_rule.rationale: A helper may have applied a side effect before losing the receipt. Reconciliation precedes any replacement.

late_ack_rule.terminal_or_superseded_ack_behavior: record as stale/orphan evidence; do not advance control state
